decision: Dropbox folder names can mislead: '992 GT3RS Exhaust Scan' holds a zip of 992 GT3 (non-RS) exhaust scan STLs, not footage

decision: Scan base: full car 25M tris -> 3 mm decimate -> crop -> prep (car.json canonical frame); every part prepped --like car.json
why: Parts on Drive share the full car's Artec frame (verified: overlay render of all 17 parts sits on the car)

decision: X-ray explode base = full car with the 12 exploded parts carved out (faces within 10 mm of each part scan), car_carved.blend
why: No 'part removed' scans exist; carving makes the part leave a real gap instead of a duplicate. Two flat ground fragments behind the rear bumper deleted

decision: Exploded parts rendered silver over a grey x-ray car (project copy of scan_render.py with --part-look)
why: All-xray (cyan) test made the parts unreadable against the car; silver parts on grey glass read as 'these are the scanned aero parts'

decision: End card = GT3 RS (992) 3D-scan listing (illumaesthetic.com/products/porsche-911-gt3-rs-3d-scan); final scan shot ends on cam_listing solved by silhouette fit to the listing's 360 viewer (WebZoom frame 0: focus 938,885, scale 1.2)
why: 240SX lesson: end the scan on the listing hero angle and dissolve so it reads as one object; edge error ~6 px

decision: Blender lens shift (sensor_fit HORIZONTAL) is in units of frame WIDTH: cx = W/2 - shift_x*W, cy = H/2 + shift_y*W
why: Measured: shift 0.05 moved the render 52-54 px on a 1080-wide frame in both axes; using the long side put the listing fit 40 px off
